title: Sampling Solutions to the Modifiable Areal Unit Problem
text: maup provides data Brown, Kenny, Simko (Nature Cities, 2026+) simulated Census tract maps every U.S. county across 2000, 2010, 2020 decennial Censuses. Measuring quantities like racial segregation requires aggregating population data geographic units, choice boundaries affects resulting estimates, well-known challenge called Modifiable Areal Unit Problem (MAUP). simulated tract plans allow researchers quantify aggregation-induced variability statistic can computed Census tract data.

title: Sampling Solutions to the Modifiable Areal Unit Problem
text: Install development version GitHub :

title: Sampling Solutions to the Modifiable Areal Unit Problem
text: Harvard Dataverse API key required set environment variable DATAVERSE_KEY. See dataverse package documentation details maup_tract_map() returns named list tract-level map objects, one per county. maup_tract_plans() returns named list simulated tract plan objects, named county FIPS code.
code: library(maup)  # download simulated tract maps for New Jersey counties (2020) map_nj <- maup_tract_map('NJ', year = 2020)  # download simulated tract plans for New Jersey counties (2020) plans_nj <- maup_tract_plans('NJ', year = 2020)
